subject: git repository using r-simmer for healthcare modelling (NHS)

messages.author: 7840f0c79a42cce9
messages.subject: git repository using r-simmer for healthcare modelling (NHS)
parts:
I've been presenting and running workshops at the NHS R Conference, discussing r-simmer and its use for modelling in healthcare - specifically using a data-driven technique (essentially resampling genuine demand rather than trying to statistically model it).

 The code is a pretty minimal example, though we've used the technique to model inpatient flow through an entire hospital.

Github repository at: https://github.com/thigger/ICU-Model

Thought it might be useful to people doing something similar.

tom
